I've ported the Clojure program to Go using only the standard library. `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases, and the unit tests and `go vet` are clean.

To test larger inputs, I built the original Clojure version and ran both on a generated input of 1,000,000 commands. Their outputs matched exactly. The Go binary finished that input in about 0.1 seconds.

The code is in three places:
- **`internal/lru/lru.go`**: the cache itself. A map points into a slice of entries that are linked in usa
